title: Induction Training on Official Statistics for SSS Officers
description: Foundation programme covering the official statistical system, survey operations, sampling concepts, quality assurance, and professional conduct.

title: Refresher Programme on Survey Methodology
description: Refreshes sampling frames, questionnaire design, estimation, non-response handling, and metadata documentation for survey programmes.

title: National Accounts Compilation Workshop
description: Hands-on compilation workshop for source data validation, sectoral estimates, revisions, and national accounts quality checks.

title: Price Statistics and CPI Field Validation
description: Practical programme on item specifications, price collection, outlier validation, index basics, and field supervision.

title: Labour and Employment Statistics Programme
description: Covers labour-force concepts, employment status, indicator production, survey instruments, and interpretation.

title: Agricultural and Rural Statistics Training
description: Builds capability in crop area, yield estimation, rural indicators, administrative records, and geospatial validation.

title: SDG Indicators and Data Disaggregation
description: Focuses on SDG metadata, sub-national disaggregation, reporting schedules, validation, and dissemination.

title: Python and R Laboratory for Official Statistics
description: Hands-on lab for cleaning, analysis, reproducible scripts, visualization, and statistical reporting using Python and R.

title: SQL and Administrative Data Integration
description: Teaches database querying, validation, data linkage, administrative data quality checks, and repeatable integration pipelines.

title: GIS and Spatial Statistics Applications
description: Applies geospatial tools to maps, spatial joins, administrative boundaries, indicator dashboards, and validation.

title: AI and Machine Learning for Official Statistics
description: Introduces ML workflows, feature preparation, model evaluation, responsible AI, and use cases in official statistics.

title: Cloud, APIs, and Open Data Infrastructure
description: Covers government cloud hosting, API-driven exchange, data catalogs, open data publication, and platform operations.

title: Cybersecurity and Data Privacy for Statistical Systems
description: Builds cyber hygiene, privacy safeguards, secure access, digital signatures, incident awareness, and confidential data handling.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure and Data Exchange
description: Explains DPI components, registries, secure exchange patterns, interoperability, and governance for data platforms.

title: Leadership and Ethics in Statistical Administration
description: Develops leadership, ethical judgment, evidence-based decisions, and communication for public statistical leadership roles.

title: Project Management for Large-Scale Surveys
description: Practical training on survey workplans, team coordination, field monitoring, quality gates, risks, and reporting.

title: Decision Support Dashboards for Senior Officers
description: Uses dashboards and briefing products to support strategic decisions, prioritization, and data-driven reviews.

title: Change Management for Statistical Modernization
description: Supports teams through modernization, process redesign, digital adoption, stakeholder communication, and sustained improvement.
